email.body1:
Sarah, saw LeagueApps acquired RecTimes and added registration insurance and e-signatures, broadening the platform.

Adding products usually exposes the same RevOps gap: signals come in faster than the team can act on them, and leads cool before a rep responds. Our AI SDR closes that loop autonomously, researching, writing, and following up the moment a signal fires, around 3-5x more meetings per rep with no new headcount.

I built a personalized signal play for LeagueApps off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Sarah, quick follow-up for LeagueApps.

With a broader product line to sell, data hygiene and slow signal-to-action handoffs are usually where measurable lift hides. Adding reps doesn't fix latency, it just spreads it.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, mapped to your stack. Our best-practice patterns alone tend to lift response rates 50-70%, and I'll show where LeagueApps' sequence is likely leaking replies.
email.body3:
Sarah, last bit of proof for LeagueApps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how LeagueApps' reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Sarah, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action and proving outbound lift isn't the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition into the GTM motion is plenty of work on its own.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion? I'll tailor it to LeagueApps either way, and it's yours regardless.
